newsitem.title: USA: SFX Broadcasting to buy Secret at $300 mln.
newsitem.headline: SFX Broadcasting to buy Secret at $300 mln.

text.p: SFX Broadcasting Inc said Tuesday that it entered into a definitive agreement to purchase the assets of Secret Communications for $300 million.
The privately-owned Secret Communications operates nine radio stations in three markets.

Under the deal, SFX Broadcasting would buy the following radio stations: WDVE(FM), WXDX(FM), WDSY(FM) and WJJJ(FM) in Pittsburgh; WLTF(FM) and WTAM-AM in Cleveland; and WFBQ(FM), WRZX(FM) and WNDE-AM in Indianapolis.

"This is an excellent group of stations and we are extremely excited to be entering three new markets, particularly since we will enter Pittsburgh with the top two stations and Indianapolis with the number one station," SFX Broadcasting executive chairman Robert F. X. Sillerman said.
